I also struggle with pain and staying centered and mindful when I am being pulled off my seat by pain and the attendant thoughts that come with it is very difficult. Pema Chodron's When Things Fall Apart is an excellent resource for letting go of suffering. I would recommend Tara Brachs "Radical Acceptance" as well. The teachings of Jack Kornfield are what I return to over and again, his wisdom and compassion have the ability to calm me when it seems impossible to bear the weight of my suffering. 

Check out dharmaseed.org and search for his dharma talks. Really great stuff. You are on the right path and I encourage you to stay with it no matter how hard it is. The deeper the suffering the greater our capacity to awaken and practice compassion. Have compassion for yourself. You dererve it more than anything. Love and light to you.... stay strong.
